project.title: Year in Review 2025 - Unseen Studio
project.format: horizontal editorial timeline with video chapters and parallax text

why: A high-signal reference for turning a studio recap into an immersive editorial object: the experience uses a horizontal scroll container, a giant dashed timeline, looping media, month-based chaptering, and outbound case-study links without losing its narrative cohesion.

compositions.title: 32,000px timeline spine
compositions.study: The story rides on one oversized SVG line that behaves like a visual rail through the entire year.
compositions.reuse: Use when a long-form motion story needs one persistent orienting device instead of restarting the layout each chapter.

compositions.title: Month-by-month horizontal chapters
compositions.study: Each month is framed as its own chapter with date typography, short editorial copy, and a dedicated media beat.
compositions.reuse: Use for portfolios, annual reports, or product histories that benefit from clearly named sequential beats.

compositions.title: Intro stage with canvas and looped eye video
compositions.study: The introduction combines fixed overlay typography, a canvas layer, and a hidden autoplay eye-loop video before the month timeline begins.
compositions.reuse: Open long-form stories with one theatrical stage that teaches the interaction model before the dense content starts.

assets.role: chapter media and intro stage texture
assets.notes: The intro uses an autoplay loop and many chapters rely on looping MP4 moments instead of static thumbnails.
assets.reuse: Use short loops to keep long editorial stories visually alive without requiring full video playback controls in every panel.

assets.notes: The experience mixes mono labels, heavy condensed numerals, and script accents to make dates feel collectible rather than administrative.
assets.reuse: Treat temporal labels as a design system of their own when the story structure depends on time.

assets.role: chapter images, loops, and linked case-study references
assets.notes: Individual chapters pair media with short text and, in some cases, direct Open links to deeper case pages.
assets.reuse: Let each chapter decide whether it needs a passive media note or a link-out to a deeper artifact.

motion.title: Horizontal scroll narrative
motion.notes: The main container switches the default reading direction into a horizontal timeline that feels closer to a moving exhibition wall than a normal webpage.
motion.fallback: Reduced-motion and keyboard handling were not verified live, so reuse this pattern only when an alternate navigation path is designed up front.

motion.title: Distributed chapter loops
motion.notes: Looping video is distributed across the intro and chapter bodies so motion remains present throughout the full recap.
motion.fallback: Each loop should degrade to a readable still frame when autoplay is unavailable.

motion.title: Intro-led onboarding into the timeline
motion.notes: The opening title card, scroll instruction, and hidden webgl stage teach the experience before the dense story begins.
motion.fallback: If the animated intro is skipped, preserve the year title and scroll instruction in plain text.

interactions.title: This way onboarding cue
interactions.study: The intro explicitly tells the user that the story moves sideways, which prevents the horizontal layout from feeling like a bug.
interactions.reuse: Always teach a nonstandard scroll model with visible copy and directional affordances.

interactions.title: Chapter open links
interactions.study: Selected chapters provide Open buttons that branch into deeper work without breaking the year-in-review framing.
interactions.reuse: Use link-outs sparingly when a narrative summary needs optional deeper dives.

interactions.title: Parallax date and media choreography
interactions.study: Data-parallax attributes on years, images, and text turn the timeline into a layered motion field instead of a flat strip of cards.
interactions.reuse: Layer parallax sparingly to keep long-form storytelling tactile without overwhelming the reading flow.

implementation.format: WordPress-driven horizontal timeline with SVG rail, canvas intro stage, and looping chapter media
implementation.notes: Static inspection confirmed a horizontal scroll container, a 32,000px dashed SVG timeline, month chapters, parallax annotations, autoplay video loops, and outbound case-study links.
